identity.title: [v0.91.7][csdlc-v2][readiness] Let terminal validation supersede earlier nonterminal evidence

values.goal: Allow supported terminal closeout when a later validation observation supersedes an earlier state for the same logical validation.
values.required_outcome: Readiness and terminal validation use one shared latest-observation rule while retaining append-only evidence.
declared_scope: focused readiness and card-validation regression tests
authority_boundary: Do not weaken required local or remote gates
Do not touch runtime or product code
